_comment: Guards on adopting a late board. This edits the registry unasked, so each one is about never adopting the WRONG thing.

mutations.name: an ambiguous DFU serial adopts nothing
the type must still exist
mutations.find: if not mcu_type or mcu_type not in reg.names():

the pairing is recorded BEFORE the re-enumeration wait
